script.title: 人间渡 第1集 衣锦还乡
script.synopsis: 云游鬼医闻笙背着旧药箱路过街市，撞见衣锦还乡的状元叶生——马有影子，人有影子，叶生没有。他以【望】看破叶生心口凝着「高中」二字的执念，以【入】看见少年叶生挑灯苦读、落榜、咳血而死的记忆。叶生回到旧宅向妇人报喜，妇人却吓得摔碎了碗、指向门外：门外停着一口棺材，里面是叶生自己。叶生站在阳光里，脚下没有影子，轻声问：她在看什么？闻笙从袖中抽出了那枚不响的铃。
script.artStyle: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation film still, guoman shuimo style: strong black ink brush linework as the structural base, light translucent mineral-color washes, generous xieyi negative space, soft ink-bleed edges, misty atmosphere with warm candlelight and lantern glow against cool ink-grey tones, ethereal melancholic beauty rather than horror, delicate visible brush texture on faces and fabric, 2D animated feature film look, no photorealism, no 3D render, no cel-shaded anime
script.musicDirection: 配乐只做氛围底色：古筝泛音、箫的单音拉长、低音弦持续音床，无鼓组、无可数拍子、无抒情旋律线。有台词的段压到台词之下；揭底与收尾的段主动抽掉配乐，用现场声和静默承载。每集收尾留一段近乎绝对的静默，作为「来不及」的落点。
script.musicDirectionEn: The score is only an atmospheric bed: guzheng harmonics, sustained single xiao flute tones, and a low-string drone. No drum kit, no countable pulse, no lyrical melody. It sits below dialogue; in reveal and closing beats the score is deliberately removed so that production sound and silence carry the weight. Every episode ends in near-absolute silence as the emotional landing.

characters.name: 闻笙
characters.appearance: A young East Asian man in his mid-twenties with a cold gentle face, long black hair half-bound in a topknot with a plain wooden hairpin, distinct streaks of white hair at both temples, calm dark unblinking eyes. He wears a plain white cross-collared hanfu robe with pale grey-blue trim and a cloth belt, carries a weathered dark-brown wooden medicine chest on his back with leather shoulder straps, and a small dull bronze bell hangs silently at his waist. 2D ink-wash animation style.
characters.voice: 青年男性，中低音，清冷温润，语速缓，句子极短；前期疏离功利，渡鬼是买卖，不带悲悯
characters.voiceEn: Young adult male, mid-low register, cool and restrained with a warm undertone, slow rate, extremely short sentences; detached and transactional at this stage, no sentimentality
characters.personality: 清冷毒舌、刀子嘴豆腐心；嘴上嫌麻烦却总出手；本集台词只有「费我铃」三个字，是局外人，不是拯救者。

characters.name: 阿离
characters.appearance: A small ghost girl who looks about ten years old, pale round face, large bright dark eyes with a faint otherworldly glow, black hair in twin loops tied with red cords. She wears a pale green-and-white ruqun dress with wide sleeves; her bare feet hover slightly above the ground and the edges of her body are faintly translucent. She peeks out from behind the medicine chest. 2D ink-wash animation style.
characters.voice: 少女音，清亮灵动，带一点空灵鬼气，语速略快；看热闹时压不住好奇，害怕时往药箱后缩
characters.voiceEn: Young girl voice, clear bright and lively with a faint ethereal ghostly quality, slightly quick rate; curiosity she cannot suppress, shrinking behind the chest when scared
characters.personality: 温暖纯真担当；她说「他好像还不知道自己已经……」——说的是叶生，也是她自己，全集不点明。

characters.name: 旧药箱
characters.appearance: A weathered dark-brown wooden medicine chest with brass corner fittings, leather shoulder straps and faint carved talisman patterns on the lid, carried on Wensheng's back. It speaks with a muffled old man's voice from inside the box; the lid seam glows faintly when it talks. 2D ink-wash animation style.
characters.voice: 苍老沙哑的男声，木质感闷响，像从箱子里面传出来，慢吞吞；吐槽时节奏稍快
characters.voiceEn: Old hoarse male voice with a muffled woody resonance as if speaking from inside a wooden box, slow dragging pace, slightly quicker when snarking
characters.personality: 灵器，承载「望闻问切」；一句话点破鬼的底细，负责吐槽与信息投放。

characters.name: 叶生
characters.appearance: A gaunt young East Asian scholar in his twenties, pale sickly face with fever-bright eyes, wearing the crimson silk parade robe of a number-one scholar, a black gauze cap pinned with a red silk flower, and a red satin sash across the chest. He is a ghost who does not know he is dead: he casts NO shadow on the ground, even in full sunlight. 2D ink-wash animation style.
characters.voice: 年轻书生男声，清亮带喜气，语速略快；病气藏在底气里，笑垮掉的时候声音发虚
characters.voiceEn: Young scholarly male voice, bright and jubilant, slightly quick rate; a hidden sickly weakness underneath, turning hollow when his smile collapses
characters.personality: 执念鬼，不知己死；全部悲喜都系在「高中」二字上；他的恐怖不靠狰狞，靠他在阳光里没有影子。

characters.name: 妇人（叶生之妻）
characters.appearance: A young East Asian woman in her twenties, hair in a simple home bun held by a wooden pin, wearing a plain faded indigo home dress; a gentle face now drained of all color with fright. 2D ink-wash animation style.
characters.voice: 年轻妇人声，温柔；受惊时气声发紧，说不出完整的字
characters.voiceEn: Young woman, gentle; her breath tightens into a broken whisper when frightened, unable to form a whole word
characters.personality: 全剧第一个「看见鬼的活人」；她的恐惧是观众确认叶生已死的唯一人证。

scenes.title: 街市 · 状元桥
scenes.location: A bustling ancient Chinese market street at a stone arch bridge in daylight: firecracker confetti covering flagstones, a celebratory homecoming parade with gongs and suona horns, red banners, crowds lining the street, the number-one scholar approaching on a tall horse. Ink-wash animation, warm festive reds against cool grey stone.
scenes.summary: 衣锦还乡的队伍过桥，叶生披红挂彩接受贺喜；闻笙逆着人流停在桥边，看见马有影子、人有影子、叶生没有。阿离从药箱后探头看热闹。
scenes.refImagePath: storage/works/人间渡/episodes/u1-ep01-02-叶生/ep01/media/images/场景/状元桥街市.png

scenes.title: 状元桥边 · 望
scenes.location: The bridgehead edge of the same market street, daylight; Wensheng standing still against the crowd flow, the parade passing close in front of him, red silk ribbons sweeping past his face.
scenes.summary: 闻笙起【望】：叶生胸口浮着一层灰，灰中央凝着「高中」二字。旧药箱点破「能渡，费劲」，闻笙只答「费我铃」。阿离说漏了半句：他好像还不知道自己已经……
scenes.refImagePath: storage/works/人间渡/episodes/u1-ep01-02-叶生/ep01/media/images/场景/状元桥街市.png

scenes.title: 叶生旧宅 · 院外（记忆闪回）
scenes.location: Outside a dilapidated old residence in daylight, then dissolving into ink-wash memory pages: a drafty room at night where a teenage scholar studies by an oil lamp, walls plastered with failed examination lists, lamp oil running out as he coughs blood onto his paper, brush still in hand.
scenes.summary: 闻笙指尖结印起【入】：叶生的记忆像旧书页翻过来——挑灯苦读、张张落榜、灯尽咳血。闻笙的眉头几不可察地动了一下。

scenes.title: 叶生旧宅 · 堂屋
scenes.location: The main hall of the old residence, daylight through the door: a worn wooden table, an ancestral altar table against the back wall with lit candlesticks, faded couplets on the pillars, a woman in a faded indigo home dress. Ink-wash interior with dust motes in the light shaft.
scenes.summary: 叶生大步跨进堂屋报喜「我中了」；妇人抬头看见他，脸色刷白，碗摔碎在地上，后退撞上供桌，躲开他伸来的手，发抖的手指指向门外。

scenes.title: 旧宅门外 · 棺材
scenes.location: The doorway threshold of the old residence looking out, bright daylight on an empty flagstone street; to Wensheng's eyes a black-lacquered coffin rests outside the door with its lid half open, a gaunt dead scholar lying inside — Ye Sheng himself. Ye Sheng stands in full sunlight casting no shadow.
scenes.summary: 叶生走到门口，门外阳光正好、空空荡荡；只有闻笙看见那口棺材和里面的叶生自己。叶生轻声问「她在看什么？」，闻笙从袖中抽出了那枚不响的铃。

wan3ReferencePaths: storage/works/人间渡/episodes/u1-ep01-02-叶生/ep01/media/images/场景/状元桥街市.png
shots.action: 鞭炮炸得满街纸屑，衣锦还乡的队伍从状元桥那头过来。叶生骑高头大马、披红挂彩，下巴微抬接受贺喜——阳光把马和人的影子投在青石板上，只有他没有影子。闻笙素白长衫、背着旧药箱逆着人流停在桥边，阿离从药箱后探出半个脑袋。闻笙把肩上药箱带子紧了紧。
shots.actionEn: Firecrackers shower the street with red confetti as the homecoming parade crosses the stone arch bridge. Ye Sheng rides a tall horse in crimson parade silk, chin lifted to the cheers — the horse and the crowd cast clear shadows on the flagstones, only he casts none. Wensheng, in a plain white robe with the old medicine chest on his back, stands still against the crowd flow at the bridgehead; Ali peeks out from behind the chest. Wensheng tightens the chest strap on his shoulder.

lines.emotion: 清亮灵动，压着声音的好奇

shots.sfx: 密集的鞭炮炸响、人群贺喜声、喜庆唢呐与锣鼓、马蹄踏青石板
shots.sfxEn: Dense firecracker bursts, cheering crowds, festive suona and gongs, horse hooves on flagstones
shots.wan3EndState: 队伍继续从桥上经过，叶生仍骑在马上接受贺喜且脚下没有影子；闻笙在桥边站定，阿离半藏在药箱后，三者的空间关系保持不变。
shots.note: 全集第一个镜头。「叶生无影」是本集最重要的视觉信息，必须由首帧像素级承载（马影、人影齐全、他脚下空），不能交给视频模型自由发挥。首帧构图：队伍在画面纵深中段，闻笙与药箱在前景桥边，两者视线关系要成立。

shots.action: 闻笙眼皮微垂，瞳孔里极轻地亮了一下——【望】。他的视野里，叶生胸口浮着一层化不开的灰，灰的中央凝着「高中」两个字，顺着心口往外渗，像一件穿了十年的旧衫。旧药箱闷闷地开口。叶生骑马经过，红绸带差点扫到闻笙的脸。
shots.actionEn: Wensheng's eyelids lower; a faint light kindles in his pupils — the Sight. In his vision, a layer of undissolvable grey clings to Ye Sheng's chest, two characters condensing at its center — 'Passed' — seeping outward like a shirt worn for ten years. The old medicine chest speaks in a muffled voice. Ye Sheng rides past, a red silk ribbon nearly brushing Wensheng's face.

lines.text: 这鬼执念深得很，能渡，就是费劲。
lines.emotion: 苍老沙哑、木质感闷响，慢吞吞

lines.text: 他好像还不知道，自己已经……

shots.sfx: 药箱内部一声闷响；人群喜乐渐渐退远，像隔了一层水
shots.sfxEn: A muffled thump from inside the medicine chest; the festive crowd noise receding as if underwater
shots.wan3EndState: 叶生骑马从闻笙面前经过，红绸带掠过后仍在队伍中前行；闻笙保持望向他胸口的姿势，阿离缩在药箱后，灰气与「高中」二字稳定留在主观视野中。

shots.action: 闻笙不远不近地跟着，指尖在袖中结印——【入】。叶生的记忆像旧书页翻过来：漏风屋子里少年叶生挑灯苦读；一张张落榜的榜文；灯油将尽，他伏在案上咳血，笔还握在手里。墨色退去，闻笙的眉头几不可察地动了一下。
shots.actionEn: Wensheng follows at a distance, fingers forming a seal inside his sleeve — the Entry. Ye Sheng's memories turn like old book pages: a teenage scholar studying by an oil lamp in a drafty room; wall after wall of failed examination lists; the lamp oil dying as he coughs blood onto his paper, brush still in hand. The ink recedes; Wensheng's brow moves almost imperceptibly.

shots.sfxEn: The crisp turn of old book pages; three distant night-watch drums; paper stirred by a draft; one suppressed cough
shots.wan3EndState: 翻页式记忆停在少年叶生伏案咳血、笔仍握在手中，墨色退回现实后闻笙站在原处，闻笙与叶生的空间关系不变。

shots.action: 叶生大步跨进堂屋，满脸衣锦还乡的喜色报喜。堂屋里的妇人抬头看见他，脸色刷地白了，手里的碗摔碎在地上。她一步步往后退，后背撞上供桌，烛台晃了晃。叶生伸手去扶，她猛地躲开，喉咙里挤出一声不像人声的呜咽。
shots.actionEn: Ye Sheng strides into the main hall, glowing with triumph, announcing his success. The woman looks up, sees him, and the color drains from her face; the bowl shatters on the floor. She backs away step by step until her back hits the altar table, rattling the candlesticks. Ye Sheng reaches out to steady her; she flinches away, a sound that is not quite human squeezed from her throat.

lines.emotion: 清亮、喜气冲顶，一句比一句高

shots.note: 碗碎是本场的声音锚点，配乐在碗碎后整个抽掉。妇人的恐惧是观众确认叶生已死的唯一人证，她的脸必须给足。

shots.action: 叶生的笑僵在脸上，手还停在半空。妇人张着嘴说不出一个完整的字，发抖的手指缓缓指向门外。叶生顺着她的手指，慢慢转头看向门口。
shots.actionEn: Ye Sheng's smile freezes on his face, his hand still hanging in mid-air. The woman's mouth opens but no whole word comes out; her trembling finger slowly points toward the door. Ye Sheng follows her finger and turns his head toward the doorway.
shots.sfx: 妇人喉咙里不成调的呜咽；烛火哔剥；门外死一样的安静
shots.sfxEn: A tuneless whimper in the woman's throat; candle wicks crackling; dead silence outside the door

shots.action: 叶生转身往门外走。门外阳光正好，空空荡荡，什么也没有。但墙影里的闻笙看见：门口停着一口黑漆棺材，棺盖半开，里面躺着一个瘦得脱了形的人，正是叶生自己。叶生站在光里，脚下干干净净——没有影子。
shots.actionEn: Ye Sheng turns and walks toward the door. Outside, the sunlight is perfect and the street utterly empty. But Wensheng, standing in the wall shadow, sees it: a black-lacquered coffin resting by the door, lid half open, a gaunt dead scholar lying inside — Ye Sheng himself. Ye Sheng stands in full light, the ground at his feet perfectly clean — no shadow.
shots.sfx: 衣料摩擦；叶生的脚步声；风穿过空街；其余什么都没有
shots.sfxEn: Fabric rustling; Ye Sheng's footsteps; wind through the empty street; nothing else at all
shots.wan3EndState: 叶生站在明亮门外且脚下没有影子，闻笙停在墙影里；棺材与棺中尸身只存在于闻笙的视角，镜头停在无影的地面。
shots.note: 棺材只有闻笙的视角能看见、叶生本人看不见——「他不知己死」与「闻笙能看见」合在一个镜头里。棺材与棺中叶生由首帧承载；叶生脚下无影是本段落点，首帧必须画对。

shots.actionEn: Ye Sheng stands at the threshold, glances back at the woman huddled inside, then at the empty street outside, and asks his question softly. In the wall shadow, Wensheng slowly draws the silent bell from his sleeve. The frame settles on the hem of Ye Sheng's crimson robe — sunlight passes through him onto the ground, casting no shadow.

shots.sfxEn: Wind; the bell does not ring — not even a hint of metal
